title: Lenovo.DE host-groups dataset item
description: Normalized Lenovo.DE host-group identity plus collector-materialized membership summary. Membership detail is emitted directly on each row via derived arrays such as memberRefs and memberNames.

id.description: Canonical host-group identifier; primary key used by mapping joins.

ref.description: Source-native host-group reference. Keep for lineage; may match id.

systemId.description: Storage-system join key for per-system filtering and assembler partitioning.

clusterRef.description: Canonical Lenovo DE host-group membership key. Membership is derived primarily by joining hosts.clusterRef to host-groups.clusterRef or id.

hostGroupRef.description: Legacy/compatibility host-group reference retained for lineage and older payloads. Use only as a fallback when hosts.clusterRef is unavailable.

memberRefs.description: Derived summary of normalized host member identifiers. Collectors should build this primarily from hosts.clusterRef -> host-groups.clusterRef/id joins, using hosts.hostGroupRef only as a fallback for older payloads.

memberNames.description: Derived summary of normalized host member names. This is populated from the authoritative hosts.clusterRef -> host-groups.clusterRef/id relationship, with hostGroupRef retained only as a fallback for older payloads.
